entries.text: You see a man in dusty leather armor with a trenchcoat and gas mask.

entries.text: You see Tycho.
entries.source_text: You see Tycho.

entries.text: Another new face. Travelers here are a dime a dozen. But you have the# look of someone different. Care to join me for a drink?
entries.source_text:
Another new face. Travelers here are a dime a dozen. But you have the
# look of someone different. Care to join me for a drink?

entries.text: Sorry, I'm rather pressed for time.
entries.source_text: Sorry, I'm rather pressed for time.

entries.text: Sure.
entries.source_text: Sure.

entries.text: Duh-wah?
entries.source_text: Duh-wah?

entries.text: Delightful. I hope you don't mind your drink well-watered - they treat# beer here like it's a potted plant.
entries.source_text:
Delightful. I hope you don't mind your drink well-watered - they treat
# beer here like it's a potted plant.

entries.text: So, what's your story?
entries.source_text: So, what's your story?

entries.text: Yeah, a drink of water. Never mind.
entries.source_text: Yeah, a drink of water. Never mind.

entries.text: I could ask the same of you. In the interest of amity, I suppose I'll# tell first. I'm called Tycho. Came from out east, what used to be called Nevada.
entries.source_text:
I could ask the same of you. In the interest of amity, I suppose I'll
# tell first. I'm called Tycho. Came from out east, what used to be called Nevada.

entries.text: That's a pretty long trip.
entries.source_text: That's a pretty long trip.

entries.text: How did you survive all the dangers?
entries.source_text: How did you survive all the dangers?

entries.text: Yeah, it was. Decided to take it easy for a while. This place shows some# promise, just as soon as someone cleans up some of the scum.
entries.source_text:
Yeah, it was. Decided to take it easy for a while. This place shows some
# promise, just as soon as someone cleans up some of the scum.

entries.text: Why don't you?
entries.source_text: Why don't you?

entries.text: Yeah, I noticed. What do you know about those jerks?
entries.source_text: Yeah, I noticed. What do you know about those jerks?

entries.text: Had some pretty good training, and some good weapons, too. My grandfather# was a Ranger way back when, and he taught my father everything he knew. Dad# passed it on to me. So I know enough not to drink glowing water, so to speak.
entries.source_text:
Had some pretty good training, and some good weapons, too. My grandfather
# was a Ranger way back when, and he taught my father everything he knew. Dad
# passed it on to me. So I know enough not to drink glowing water, so to speak.

entries.text: Interesting. Thanks for the drink.
entries.source_text: Interesting. Thanks for the drink.

entries.text: Really? Survival's tough these days. You must be pretty knowledgeable.
entries.source_text: Really? Survival's tough these days. You must be pretty knowledgeable.

entries.text: Not my place. I'd rather not cross Killian, after all. He'll clean up# this town when he gets around to it. A good man, mark my words. But watch out# for that fellow Gizmo. Reminds me of another fat freak my father told me about# back in Las Vegas.
entries.source_text:

# this town when he gets around to it. A good man, mark my words. But watch out
# for that fellow Gizmo. Reminds me of another fat freak my father told me about
# back in Las Vegas.

entries.text: Thanks for the tip, and the drink.
entries.source_text: Thanks for the tip, and the drink.

entries.text: There's two grades of scum here. One of 'em's the Skulz, a gang that hangs# out in back of Marcelles' crash house. They're just grade-B twerps. But the other# ones answer to a fat freak whose name you can probably guess. Runs the casino.# Those guys are organized and dangerous.
entries.source_text:
There's two grades of scum here. One of 'em's the Skulz, a gang that hangs
# out in back of Marcelles' crash house. They're just grade-B twerps. But the other
# ones answer to a fat freak whose name you can probably guess. Runs the casino.
# Those guys are organized and dangerous.

entries.text: I see. Thanks for the info.
entries.source_text: I see. Thanks for the info.

entries.text: Yeah, well, my family taught me everything there is to know about survival.# Don't drink water that's totally clear and free of insects and moss, for instance.# Only poisonous or radioactive water would be that clean in the wilderness.# Lots of other little things to look out for, too.
entries.source_text:

# Don't drink water that's totally clear and free of insects and moss, for instance.
# Only poisonous or radioactive water would be that clean in the wilderness.
# Lots of other little things to look out for, too.

entries.source_text: Like what?

entries.text: Now, now, no need to get impolite. But with that attitude you'd best be# on your way.

entries.text: Sorry to disturb your private time. Go wank somewhere else.

entries.source_text: I need information about the gangers here.

entries.text: I need information about the town.
entries.source_text: I need information about the town.

entries.text: Hello again. How can I help you?
entries.source_text: Hello again. How can I help you?

entries.text: Killian's asked me to clean up this town, and I'd like your help.
entries.source_text: Killian's asked me to clean up this town, and I'd like your help.

entries.text: Well, this is the Skum Pitt, a wretched hive of villainy and all that. Just# west of here is Gizmo's, a big casino. Word is the games are rigged. A little south# of here is the Crash House, run by Marcelles, where you can get a night's sleep# for way too many caps. Past that is Killian's. Killian runs a general store, and# he also enforces the law in this town - a good man. Then south of there you have# Doc Morbid, whose operation is a little funny, if you take my meaning.
entries.source_text:
Well, this is the Skum Pitt, a wretched hive of villainy and all that. Just
# west of here is Gizmo's, a big casino. Word is the games are rigged. A little south
# of here is the Crash House, run by Marcelles, where you can get a night's sleep
# for way too many caps. Past that is Killian's. Killian runs a general store, and
# he also enforces the law in this town - a good man. Then south of there you have
# Doc Morbid, whose operation is a little funny, if you take my meaning.

entries.text: I hope that my little instruction course helped a bit.
entries.source_text: I hope that my little instruction course helped a bit.

entries.text: Word out is that you've been having some contacts with Gizmo. I'd step# carefully around that barrel of lard if I were you.
entries.source_text:
Word out is that you've been having some contacts with Gizmo. I'd step

entries.text: My business is none of yours.
entries.source_text: My business is none of yours.

entries.text: Yeah, I work for Gizmo now. What's it to you?
entries.source_text: Yeah, I work for Gizmo now. What's it to you?

entries.text: Fair enough. But watch your back. Gizmo isn't known for his consideration# for his employees.
entries.source_text:
Fair enough. But watch your back. Gizmo isn't known for his consideration
# for his employees.

entries.text: Suffice to say that your employer has caused more than enough misery and# strife in this town. Don't expect much help from anyone, least of all Gizmo.# Too bad. You might've been able to change this town for the better.
entries.source_text:

# strife in this town. Don't expect much help from anyone, least of all Gizmo.

entries.text: What can I do for you?
entries.source_text: What can I do for you?

entries.text: Any recommendations?
entries.source_text: Any recommendations?

entries.text: Thanks for your help. I think it's time to part ways.
entries.source_text: Thanks for your help. I think it's time to part ways.

entries.text: Yeah, I'd stay the hell away from whatever made that. Seriously, I've never# seen anything like that. I think our best option is to move on, fast.
entries.source_text:
Yeah, I'd stay the hell away from whatever made that. Seriously, I've never
# seen anything like that. I think our best option is to move on, fast.

entries.text: Very well. I must say that it has been an honor and a pleasure.
entries.source_text: Very well. I must say that it has been an honor and a pleasure.

entries.text: Watch out for radioactive hot spots. This place obviously sustained a# direct nuclear strike, and secondary cascade radiation may be bad. I'd# recommend avoiding this place completely if we can.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Note the lack of any animal life for quite a distance. And the piles of# bones. Whatever lives here is a real beast. Keep your weapon handy.

entries.text: Well, Junktown's not really home, but it's an interesting city. It has# potential, although I don't know that building out of the refuse of the past is #the# best way to construct the future.

# best way to construct the future.

entries.text: We Rangers hail from back east, what used to be called Nevada. Our# heritage stretches back to the days of the Texas Rangers. We learn survival and# combat skills in order to go out into the world and have a chance of surviving and# making things better.
entries.source_text:
We Rangers hail from back east, what used to be called Nevada. Our
# heritage stretches back to the days of the Texas Rangers. We learn survival and
# combat skills in order to go out into the world and have a chance of surviving and
# making things better.

entries.text: I haven't seen a relic of old technology like a water chip for a long# time. Personally, you're better off depending on yourself, not on some piece of# tech that you can't fix.

# time. Personally, you're better off depending on yourself, not on some piece of

entries.text: The War was a testament to human greed and insanity. Let's hope that we# have learned enough to never repeat such folly.

entries.text: The wastes are hostile and dangerous, even to the wary traveler.# Radiation and strange creatures will take their toll. Tread with caution, and# remember that everything you see and hear is a clue.

entries.text: 其实，迦克镇不是什么家园，不过是个有趣的地方。很有发展潜力，虽然我不确定否定过去的建设是构建未来的最好方法。
entries.source_text: 其实，迦克镇不是什么家园，不过是个有趣的地方。很有发展潜力，虽然我不确定否定过去的建设是构建未来的最好方法。

entries.text: 我们这些流浪的人从东面来，一个曾经被称作内华达的地方。我们是德克卅斯流浪者的后裔。我们学习生存和战斗技巧用来走到外面的世界去寻找改善生存的机会。
entries.source_text: 我们这些流浪的人从东面来，一个曾经被称作内华达的地方。我们是德克卅斯流浪者的后裔。我们学习生存和战斗技巧用来走到外面的世界去寻找改善生存的机会。
